full_script: Two billionaire friends who were rival airline owners agreed to a crazy bet with their egos on the line. They both owned competing airlines and Formula One racing teams. So they agreed: whoever's team finishes last has to dress as a female flight attendant and serve drinks on the winner's airline. When Richard Branson's team came last, he kept his word. He shaved his legs, kept his beard, put on lipstick, heels, and the full rival uniform. He did the safety demo and served drinks. But while serving juice, he realized the passenger was Tony Fernandez, the rival he lost the bet to. So naturally, he accidentally dumped an entire tray of orange juice right onto his lap. Tony spent the rest of the flight in his underwear on his own airplane. Man, if I'm ever rich, I want to be like these guys.
